ecdlp_256.problem: ECDLP on a prime-order group of the given size
ecdlp_256.model: Pollard rho / van Oorschot-Wiener: ~1.25 * sqrt(q) group operations
ecdlp_256.note: the generic-group model is proven optimal to within a constant, so a refutation would have to exhibit non-generic structure, which the structural audit enumerates and rules out

field_dlp_256.problem: DLP in F_p (not on an elliptic curve)
field_dlp_256.note: sub-exponential, and still about 2^46 at 256 bits, which is why 256-bit F_p Diffie-Hellman is not used and why logjam-style precomputation was possible
